content.title: Vendors
content.summary: Vendor applications for the 2026 Arvada festivals, including the Kite Festival, Summerfest, and Independence Day Fireworks, are now open. Accepted vendors will be notified via email within a week of applying, and must adhere to specific requirements, including using compostable serving materials and providing their own tent and equipment. Refunds for cancellations are available until May 24, 2026, and vendors must comply with all local health and safety regulations.
content.body:
Vendor applications for 2026 festivals are now open!

- [Arvada Kite Festival Vendor Application](https://arvadafestivals.regfox.com/2026-kite-festival)
- [Arvada Summerfest Vendor Application](https://arvadafestivals.regfox.com/2026-arvada-summerfest)
- [Independence Day Fireworks Food Truck Application](https://arvadafestivals.regfox.com/2026-arvada-independence-day-fireworks)

## Application Information

You will be notified via email within one week of applying whether or not you have been accepted into the event. If your application is accepted, you will be emailed an info. packet at least 7 days before the event date. When applying, you will be pre-registered with your credit card but we will NOT process the payment until after you have been accepted into the event.

**Contact Information: You will only be receiving communications from this platform, [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#5435362126203b3a143526223530357a3b2633), or [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2b474f424a516b4a595d4a4f4a0544594c). Please be aware of scammers. If you have any concerns, please email us or call Adelle at (720) 898-7403. The City of Arvada Festivals Commission will never ask Vendors to send payments to a personal email address.**

### General Information

- Please have all your information submitted before the deadline.
- Spaces are assigned on a first-come, first-served basis after review and acceptance. Applicants will be notified via email if they are accepted into the event. The City of Arvada and/or Arvada Festivals Commission will select Vendors that are in accordance with the best interests of the event.
- Vendors will be assigned one or two 10' x 10' booth spaces based on your selection.
- The City of Arvada and/or Arvada Festivals Commission reserves the right to assign vendor booth locations. **The City of Arvada and/or Arvada Festivals Commission reserves the right to control or halt any activities of any vendor that disturbs the operation of this event. The City of Arvada and/or Arvada Festivals Commission reserves the right to limit the number and type of businesses at the event.**
- **Cancellations/Refunds:**  This event is a fundraiser. Refunds for cancellations will be honored until May 24. Post May 24, there will be no refunds for cancellations.

### Requirements

- Applications MUST be submitted by the due date. Please see applications for exact date.
- All Vendors are responsible for collecting and paying applicable taxes and for obtaining required licenses or permits. For more information about sales tax, call the Colorado Department of Revenue at 303-238-3278, or visit [www.taxcolorado.com](//www.taxcolorado.com).
- For safety reasons, all Vendors must provide their own covered and weighted tent (if using one), and equipment (tables, chairs, etc.) Staking down tents will NOT be permitted!**If you cannot weigh down your tent, you WILL be asked to leave and no refund will be given. You do have the option to go without a tent.**
- Please list the day-of phone number and email so that you can be reached should any unforeseen circumstances develop.
- All booths and displays **must remain up until the end of the festival**. If you take down early, this may hinder your acceptance into future festivals.
- Food Vendors must lay down a tarp or cardboard to catch grease and waste.
- Propane heaters and open flames are not allowed under tents.
- All Food Vendors must be registered with the Tri-County Health Department for this event. For more information, call (303) 439-5921 or visit tchd.org. If you do not comply, you may be asked to leave the event with no refund.

### Sustainability and Zero Waste Pledge

- **All Vendors** - If serving food or samples, MUST use recycling or compostable serving materials. There are no exceptions. If you do not use recycling or compostable serving materials at the event, your card will be automatically charged a $250 Sustainability Fee.
- **Zero Waste Pledge** -  If you have been accepted into the event, and you are a food-related vendor, you must complete the [Zero Waste Pledge](https://arvada.form.transform.civicplus.com/47819). You will NOT be allowed to participate in the event until this agreement has been completed.
- If you have any questions, email Adelle at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#4120233433352e2f012033372025206f2e3326)
